mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5 percentage points, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 7.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad-based economic weakness across consumer and business sectors, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% per annum compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the prior month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increased over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in residential construction that reduces economic activity and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 1000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% and unemployment (UNRATE) above 7.5% signals stagflation, which erodes corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and UNRATE > 7.5, or Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a deceleration in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized rate signals an economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions with GDPC1 growth below 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
